about_body: ForgeQuest for iPhone. Your data stays on this phone.
gate_step_add: Choose Add to Home Screen (under More if you don't see it)
gate_step_open: Open ForgeQuest from your Home Screen
gate_step_share: In Safari, tap ⋯ then Share (or the Share button in Safari's toolbar)
gate_title: Add ForgeQuest to your Home Screen
gate_why: Your data stays in the Home Screen app, so ForgeQuest works only from there.
